name: RichTextEditor
purpose: Edit schema-based rich text with bold, italic, lists, links and undo/redo using a mature text editing engine.
description: Schema-based rich text with Tiptap/ProseMirror selection, editing, clipboard and history.

guidance.overview: Edit schema-based rich text with bold, italic, lists, links and undo/redo using a mature text editing engine.
usage: Feed accepted document changes back to value. External replacements can reposition selection; coordinate revisions and persistence outside the editor rather than treating this as a collaborative document protocol.
Validate meaningful document content before submission and validate/sanitize downstream rendering according to the application. The link policy and restricted schema are not a general HTML sanitizer.
accessibility: Tiptap 3.32.1 / ProseMirror with limited StarterKit schema; Base UI Toolbar and shared Modal/TextInput/Button.
intent: No tables, headings, media, file upload, comments, collaborative editing or raw HTML value API.
Editor initializes on the client; server-rendered output does not contain an interactive ProseMirror editor.
Toolbar and link-dialog copy is currently English. The host must supply a meaningful editor name.
context: Use the authored rich-text-editor contract and its linked checks to assess behavior; source linkage is not certification.
